headword: {弱|よわ}り{目|め}に{祟|たた}り{目|め}
gloss: misfortune on top of misfortune; when it rains, it pours

definitions.gloss: misfortune on top of misfortune; when it rains, it pours
definitions.explanation: A proverb for fresh bad luck striking someone who is already down. {弱|よわ}り{目|め} is a moment of weakness and {祟|たた}り{目|め} a moment of divine punishment, so the saying piles one on the other.

examples.japanese: {弱|よわ}り{目|め}に{祟|たた}り{目|め}だ。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひいたうえ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{弱|よわ}り{目|め}に{祟|たた}り{目|め}だ。
examples.english: I caught a cold and then lost my wallet too. When it rains, it pours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒産|とうさん}した→倒産する：26990_tousansuru⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{弱|よわ}り{目|め}に{祟|たた}り{目|め}だった。
examples.english: Having the house wrecked by a typhoon right after the company went under was truly one disaster on top of another.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually said about one's own bad luck, or in sympathy: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弱|よわ}り{目|め}に{祟|たた}り{目|め}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧. Close English equivalents are "when it rains, it pours" and "misfortunes never come singly."

SIMILAR WORDS:

- ⟦{踏|ふ}んだり{蹴|け}ったり→踏んだり蹴ったり：31639_fundarikettari⟧: being hit by one bad thing after another (conversational)
